name: Mapo tofu
steps: Gently simmer tofu cubes in water; drain.
Brown pork with minced garlic, then stir in doubanjiang.
Add stock and tofu. Simmer gently for 5–7 minutes.
Thicken with a little cornstarch slurry; finish with Sichuan pepper and scallion.

name: Korean mixed rice
steps: Slice carrot. Cook each vegetable separately with a little oil.
Divide hot rice between two bowls.
Arrange vegetables over rice and top each bowl with a fried egg.
Add gochujang and sesame oil; mix together before eating.

name: Miso soup
steps: Soak wakame and cut tofu into small cubes.
Bring dashi to a gentle simmer; add tofu and wakame.
Turn heat off. Dissolve miso in a ladle of warm broth, then stir it in.
Top with scallion. Serve warm without boiling the miso.

name: Tom yum shrimp soup
ingredients: 3 makrut lime leaves; chili to taste
Fish sauce and lime juice, to taste
steps: Bruise lemongrass. Simmer with stock, galangal and lime leaves for 8 minutes.
Add mushrooms and chili; simmer until mushrooms soften.
Add shrimp and cook until opaque throughout.
Turn off heat, season with fish sauce and lime juice; remove tough aromatics before eating.

name: Fresh spring rolls
steps: Prepare cooked noodles, cooked shrimp and sliced vegetables.
Dip one wrapper briefly into warm water and lay flat.
Add lettuce, noodles, herbs and shrimp to the lower third.
Fold sides inward and roll snugly. Repeat; serve with dipping sauce.

name: Coconut rice
ingredients: 200 ml coconut milk; water as needed
steps: Rinse rice. Add coconut milk and enough water for your rice cooker’s usual liquid level.
Add pandan if using; cook until rice is tender.
Prepare boiled eggs, cucumber and roasted peanuts.
Serve coconut rice with the toppings and a spoonful of sambal.

name: Indonesian fried rice
steps: Finely chop garlic and shallot. Fry in a little oil until fragrant.
Add rice and stir-fry until piping hot.
Stir in kecap manis and sliced scallion.
Top with fried eggs and serve with cucumber.

name: Chicken adobo
steps: Brown chicken in a little oil.
Add crushed garlic, soy sauce, vinegar, water, bay leaves and peppercorns.
Bring to a simmer; cover and cook until chicken is cooked through and tender.
Uncover and reduce sauce slightly. Serve with rice.
